objective.statement: Change the text on HomeView.tsx from "ADA plugin test" to "New ADA chore text".

complexity.rationale: One literal text change in a single view and its component test.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The red bordered square in HomeView.tsx shows "New ADA chore text" and no longer shows "ADA plugin test".

in.statement: src/views/home/HomeView.tsx and its colocated component test.

out.statement: Styling, size, border or any other view or component.

observations.statement: The text is the child of the div with data-id HOME_VIEW_TEST_IDS.redBorderedSquare in HomeView.tsx.

capabilityOwners.rationale: Static presentational text; no state needed.

integration.rationale: No cross-module flow changes; full suite run as regression.

e2e.rationale: Static text with no user flow; component test covers it.

increments.behavior: HomeView renders "New ADA chore text" inside the red bordered square.
increments.doneWhen: t-1 passes and the full test suite stays green.

tests.description: HomeView shows "New ADA chore text" inside the red bordered square.

expectedRedEvidence.expectedFailure: Square still contains "ADA plugin test" instead of "New ADA chore text".
expectedRedEvidence.observedFailure: 1 of 6 tests failed: expected text content "New ADA chore text", received "ADA plugin test".

verification.requirement: npm test, npm run lint and npm run build pass.
verification.command: npm test; npm run lint; npm run build
verification.result: 24 unit and 40 component tests pass, lint clean, build ok; independent reviewer: approve-with-notes
